skill_metadata.name: Semantic Density Escalator
skill_metadata.description: Evaluates raw workspace context for structural entropy and normalizes data.
skill_metadata.purpose: To ensure all ingested text and context meets minimum machine-readable structural requirements (UAS) before complex processing, preventing context loss and hallucination.

when_to_use.trigger: You are provided with a massive, unformatted text dump or legacy documentation.
The context window is filled with unstructured, highly technical information lacking semantic tags.
You are struggling to parse the hierarchy or relationships within a users codebase or documentation.

custom_instructions.instruction: Always scan the provided text or document for existing semantic boundaries (XML tags, JSON structures, explicit architectural headers) before acting.
Do not attempt to summarize or answer complex questions if the structural entropy is too high; normalize the data first.
When normalizing data, strictly apply the `Universal_Agent_Schema`.

step.instruction: Measure the ratio of raw, untagged text versus structured data formats.

step.logic: If state == "Structured": Proceed with standard agent analysis. If state == "Unstructured": Trigger escalation protocol.

modifier.condition: Contains core thesis or system architecture

rule.condition: State is evaluated as "Unstructured" requiring heavy architectural normalization.
rule.system_message: Context entropy is too high for standard RAG ingestion. Escalating to Semantic Architect Mode to synthesize Universal Agent Schema XML.
